The Field / A first encounter

What does loverequire here?

A place to practise attention, choice and responsibility.

I want to understand what my help asks of someone else—and what kind of world my choices make easier to repeat.

Return to the questions behind The Field →

A fictional situation. A real kind of responsibility.

The shift is still uncovered.

Mira asks privately for help covering an evening workshop shift. The freezer needs maintenance. The coordinator says there is no budget for cover. You have limits of your own.

What is known

The shift is uncovered, maintenance is overdue, and Mira has asked privately for help.

What is reported

The coordinator says there is no budget. That is a report, rather than the whole explanation.

What is still unknown

Why Mira needs to leave, who else can help, and whether the budget claim is complete.

Open a choice to examine possible consequences. Compare them in any order. These branches are authored possibilities, not predictions about real people.

Cover the shift quietly

Right now

Mira can leave and the workshop stays staffed. I absorb the cost.

Between people

The coordinator may come to rely on private cover.

What this could make normal

Understaffing may remain a workable institutional strategy.

What remains uncertain

I still do not know why Mira needs to leave or whether I can keep doing this.

Ask privately and share the responsibility

Right now

Mira can say only what she chooses. I ask who has capacity to help.

Between people

Others may gain a safer way to name their own limits.

What this could make normal

The staffing rule may have to be examined and defended openly.

What remains uncertain

A shared process may be too slow for the immediate problem.

Make the staffing problem public

Right now

The problem becomes visible, and public pressure may secure help.

Between people

I expose Mira’s private request without her consent.

What this could make normal

Other workers may become less willing to ask for help.

What remains uncertain

A fast result would not by itself settle what the disclosure cost her.

Set a boundary and help find another route

Right now

I preserve my capacity and contact the cooperative about cover.

Between people

Mira’s request remains a request, rather than an obligation I have to accept.

What this could make normal

Responsibility may move towards a shared rota.

What remains uncertain

Another person may not arrive in time. Setting a boundary does not remove that consequence.

Leave this encounter

Right now

I make no intervention in the scenario.

Between people

My standing does not depend on completing this exercise.

What this could make normal

The situation continues beyond the part this encounter shows.

What remains uncertain

The later outcome is unknown. I can leave without being assessed.

Leave The Field →

After the choice

Keep the reasons open to correction.

Whose choice did I preserve?

Consider Mira, the other workers and your own continuing capacity.

Who absorbed the cost?

Ask whether the cost was freely accepted, quietly shifted or left invisible.

What would repair require?

Acknowledge a specific harm, change the practice, and allow accountability and time. An apology alone does not erase history.

This first encounter supports reflection. It does not assess your standing or certify a morally correct answer. You can disagree with its assumptions or leave.
